title: Mandelbrot Operators: Fractal Recursion Meets the RSA Genome
summary: A dialogue between David Freed and GPT exploring the deep structural analogy between Mandelbrot set generation (z_{n+1} = z_n^2 + c) and the RSA recursive kernel, culminating in the synthesis that RSA is a multi-operator Mandelbrot system constrained to a thermodynamic critical surface at γ = 1.
